t: Ghost Dimension: Haunted Weir Mill
d: The Ghost Dimension team visits Weir Mill, the oldest and most paranormally active mill in Stockport.

t: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: The Framing of Sirhan, Sirhan
d: Was Presidential hopeful, Robert F. Kennedy really killed by  disgruntled Palestinian Sirhan Sirhan as we’ve been led to believe? Or was he another in a long line of Manchurian candidates, a victim of a long standing mind control program.

t: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: Past Life Regression Pt. 2
d: Richard witnesses a municipal employee in Toronto, Canada undergo a regression during which he re-experiences a previous life as a doctor in early 20 century England.

t: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: Bible Codes
d: Does the Bible contain hidden messages encoded within certain passages of the Old Testament?  Is the prophetic nature of these 'codes' proof the Bible's author is of supernatural or extraterrestrial origin?

t: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: Journey to the Center of the Earth
st: Journey to the Center of the Earth
d: Richard interviews the expedition organizer who is planning on leading a team of scientists, filmmakers and tourists to the Arctic aboard a Russian nuclear ice-breaker in search of an entrance into the interior of our world.

t: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett
d: Richard meets members of the 9/11 Truth movement who challenge the official version of events concerning the attack on the U.S. Pentagon. Researchers present evidence to suggest the attack was perpetrated by some rogue element inside the U.S. government.

t: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: Osama Bin Laden
d: Richard investigates claims that the supposed mastermind behind the 9/11 terrorist attacks and leader of the Al Qaeda terrorist cell remained a CIA asset until his death.

t: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: The Dangers of EMF (Electro Magnetic Frequencies)
st: The Dangers of EMF (Electro Magnetic Frequencies)
d: Can radiation from electrical appliances, power lines, microwave ovens, and wireless technology such as cell phones, baby monitors, alter our DNA, and cause illnesses?

t: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: Alien Abductions
d: Richard speaks with two alleged alien abductees about their claims they were taken aboard an alien space craft.

t: Past Hunters: Carnfield Hall
d: Carnfield Hall is a country house dating from the 15th and 16th Centuries. This private residence turn event hall is using its paranormal activity to draw in business. Are these spirits the old residents?

t: Past Hunters: Tutbury Castle
d: The team head to Tutbury Castle in Derbyshire to investigate the paranormal reports at the location. Past Hunters appear to have caught the Tutbury Ghost on camera.

t: Past Hunters: Ordsall Hall
d: Ordsall Hall is over 820 years old. It has been put to many uses including a family home, working men's club and church hall. With over 15 hauntings and many sightings, Ordsall Hall will certainly keep the team busy.

t: My Haunted House: Don't Go Upstairs and Swerve
d: Two brothers discover a horrifying secret when they inherit a relative's home. A school teacher struggles to learn the identity of the child-like spirit that's stalking her.

t: My Haunted House: Paralyzed and The Baby Thief
d: A man suffering from sleep paralysis captures evidence that something is entering his room. A pregnant woman fears something is trying to harm her unborn child.

t: My Haunted House: The Innkeeper and Quarantine
d: A boy tells his babysitter that a man called "The Keeper" visits his room in the night. A recovering addict realizes the visions he's seeing at a remote cabin are not hallucinations.

t: Buzzfeed Unsolved: The Mysterious Death of the Somerton Man / The Horrifying Unsolved Slaughter at Hinterkaifeck Farm
st: The Mysterious Death of the Somerton Man / The Horrifying Unsolved Slaughter at Hinterkaifeck Farm
d: Ryan and Brent delve into the Somerton Man, a farm slaughter, a hotel murder and the deaths of nine hikers.

t: Buzzfeed Unsolved: The Mysterious Deaths of Tupac Shakur and Biggie Smalls
st: The Mysterious Deaths of Tupac Shakur and Biggie Smalls
d: Ryan and Brent explore the theories surrounding the deaths of legends Tupac Shakur and Biggie Smalls.

t: Buzzfeed Unsolved: The Horrifying Murders of the Zodiac Killer
st: The Horrifying Murders of the Zodiac Killer
d: Join Ryan and Brent on the hunt for clues as they delve into the chilling mystery of the Zodiac Killer.

t: Buzzfeed Unsolved: The Mysterious Disappearance of the Sodder Children / The Odd Death of Michelle Von Emster
st: The Mysterious Disappearance of the Sodder Children / The Odd Death of Michelle Von Emster
d: Ryan and Shane dive into the Sodder children's disappearance and the truth about the Micelle Von Emster case.

t: Buzzfeed Unsolved: The Terrifying Axeman of New Orleans
st: The Terrifying Axeman of New Orleans
d: Ryan and Shane explore the spine-chilling tale of the mysterious Axeman Killer of New Orleans.

t: Buzzfeed Unsolved: The Mysterious Death of the Boy in the Box / The Bizarre Road Trip of a Missing Family
st: The Mysterious Death of the Boy in the Box / The Bizarre Road Trip of a Missing Family
d: Ryan and Shane unravel the mystery of the Boy in the Box as well as the unsolved case of a missing family.

t: Buzzfeed Unsolved: The Tragic Murder of JonBenét Ramsey / The Odd Vanishing of Amelia Earhart
st: The Tragic Murder of JonBenét Ramsey / The Odd Vanishing of Amelia Earhart
d: Ryan and Shane discuss the JonBenét Ramsey case and the mystery in the disappearance of Amelia Earhart.

t: My Ghost Story: A Haunted House
d: A man and his girlfriend dream of owning their own "haunted attraction," but end up owning an actual haunted house; and the ghostly voice of a passenger who died in a plane crash is heard in a chilling recording.

t: My Ghost Story: The Demon in the Mist
d: A phantom breaches security at a South Carolina government building. A pipe-smoking ghost haunts a lighthouse. A son killed in a car accident makes his presence known to his grieving mother. A demon attacks guests at a Texas house.

t: My Ghost Story: The Hand of Death
d: A cemetery that's home to 80,000 dead souls becomes a "ghost magnet"; a family discovers that their new home is filled with the sounds of strange footsteps and whispered conversations; and more.

t: The Haunting of...: Nadine Velazquez
d: Nadine Velazquez (Flight / My Name Is Earl) has been tormented by ghosts her entire life.
